source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseLocalRuntimeRequiredDatabasePaginationCursor001Test { @isTest static void paginationCursorDeleteFilterUsesDeterministicLocalRows() { insert new Account(Name = 'Pagination'); Database.PaginationCursor cursor = Database.getPaginationCursor('SELECT Id FROM Account'); Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter deletedRowsOnly = Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.DELETED_ROWS_ONLY; Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter noDeletedRows = Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.NO_DELETED_ROWS; Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter noDeletedSharingRows = Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.NO_DELETED_SHARING_ROWS; Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter noFilter = Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.NO_FILTER; System.assertEquals(1, cursor.getNumRecords()); System.assert(noFilter.equals(noFilter)); System.assert(!noFilter.equals(deletedRowsOnly)); System.assert(!noFilter.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(noFilter.hashCode(), noFilter.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(0, deletedRowsOnly.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(1, noDeletedRows.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(2, noDeletedSharingRows.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(3, noFilter.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(noFilter, Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.valueOf('NO_FILTER')); List<Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter> values = Database.PaginationCursor.DeleteFilter.values(); System.assertEquals(4, values.size()); System.assertEquals(deletedRowsOnly, values.get(0)); System.assertEquals(noDeletedRows, values.get(1)); System.assertEquals(noDeletedSharingRows, values.get(2)); System.assertEquals(noFilter, values.get(3)); } }
